data.one_liner: Cross‑platform cryptographic algorithms for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides implementations of encryption, signatures, key exchange, hashing and more. Uses platform‑native APIs when available and falls back to pure‑Dart or WASM otherwise. Supports Android, iOS, web, desktop, and WASM.
use_when: You need cryptographic primitives (AES, ChaCha20, Ed25519, etc.) in a Flutter/Dart app
You want a single package that works on all target platforms without writing platform‑specific code
avoid_when: You require a higher‑level authentication flow (OAuth, social sign‑in)
You need a storage‑focused solution rather than crypto primitives
strengths: Pure‑Dart fallback ensures it works everywhere
Wide algorithm coverage and easy API
weaknesses: Not a full authentication framework, only low‑level crypto
Requires ffi on some platforms for Argon2id
